title: Simplicial mapping calculus with a fixed set of objects
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and the fixed-object model category $\mathrm{sCat}_O$ of [lem-coef-fixed-object-simplicial-free-calculus], and simplicial model categories and simplicial mapping spaces of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization]. Use the Kan-model simplicial sets of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $O$ be any small set, including the empty set. For $B\in\mathrm{sCat}_O$ and a small simplicial set $K$, let $B^K$ have objects $O$, mapping sets $\operatorname{Fun}(K,B(u,v))$, pointwise composition using the diagonal of $K$, and constant identity maps. There are tensors adjoint to these cotensors. With
$$\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_O(C,B)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sCat}_O}(C,B^{\Delta^n}),$$
composition and simplicial operators given by pointwise composition and restriction, the fixed-object model structure is a simplicial model category. In particular, for a cofibration $C\to D$ and a local Kan fibration $B\to B'$, the corner map
$$\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_O(D,B)\longrightarrow\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_O(C,B)\times_{\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_O(C,B')}\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_O(D,B')$$
is a Kan fibration, trivial if either input map is also a local weak equivalence. For $u,v\in O$, the pair $u=v$ allowed, let $F_{uv}(K)=F^O_{u,v}(K)$ be the free simplicial category with objects $O$ on the simplicial family $K$ of generating arrows from $u$ to $v$, with its ordinary adjunction to evaluation at $(u,v)$, of [lem-coef-fixed-object-free-arrow-adjunction]. This adjunction enriches to a simplicial Quillen adjunction $F_{uv}:\mathrm{sSet}_{\mathrm{Kan}}\rightleftarrows\mathrm{sCat}_O:\operatorname{ev}_{uv}$, with natural isomorphism
$$\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_O(F_{uv}(K),B)\cong\operatorname{Fun}(K,B(u,v)).$$

source.place: Dwyer--Kan, Simplicial localizations of categories, Section 7.1 and Proposition 7.2, printed pp.276-277 (PDF pp.9-10 zero indexed), explicitly the closed simplicial model structure on SO-Cat; the displayed cotensor and free-generator adjunction spell out its obvious simplicial structure. No Stacks tag states this theorem. Read online; archival copy WANTED.
